spec.title: Do the optimisers and the member-response surrogate generalise from the planar truss to a spatial truss (26-variable triangular girder) without domain-specific changes?
spec.hypothesis: At an equal solver budget on the 3D girder, the member-response surrogate reaches a lower median mass than the plain evolutionary algorithm and reaches the target in fewer evaluations, as it did on the planar truss; CMA-ES is between them; the global surrogate trails the member method.
